human.problem: "Did you catch how he started?" treats the baker as if they already saw the words "Perhaps the LORD will work on our behalf." They didn't. Card 10 skipped that part of 1 Samuel 14:6, so this is the first time the baker sees it. It is true that Jonathan started this way, but the card suggests the baker missed something they were never shown.
human.question: Can a story card point back to passage wording as if the baker already saw it, when no earlier card showed it?
